title: Kestrel Delivery Plan Terms: Minimum Age, Plan Switching and Cancellation Refund Terms (Delivery & Pickup Services)
content:
The following terms apply to each plan offered under Delivery & Pickup Services. The minimum age is the enrolling patient's age in whole years on the enrollment date. The full-refund window is the number of calendar days after a subscription fee is charged within which cancelling the plan refunds that fee in full. The partial refund after the window, where offered, refunds the unused whole months of the cycle.

## Terms by plan

| Term | Kestrel Pay-Per-Delivery | Kestrel Mail Delivery | Kestrel Delivery Pass Monthly | Kestrel Senior Delivery Pass | Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual | Kestrel Specialty Courier Service |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Minimum age on the enrollment date (whole years) | 18 | 18 | 18 | 65 | 18 | 18 |
| Switching to another delivery plan without cancelling | allowed | allowed | allowed | allowed | allowed | not allowed |
| When the patient's cancellation takes effect | immediately | immediately | at the end of the billing cycle | at the end of the billing cycle | immediately | immediately |
| Full-refund window after a subscription fee is charged (calendar days) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 30 | 0 |
| Unused whole months refunded when cancelling after that window | no | no | no | no | yes | no |

## Notes on the terms

- **Age.** Kestrel Senior Delivery Pass is open to a patient who is at least 65 whole years old on the enrollment date; every other plan to a patient who is at least 18.
- **Switching.** A patient holding Kestrel Specialty Courier Service cannot switch it to another delivery plan; a patient holding any of the other five plans can.
- **Cancellation timing.** The two monthly passes, Kestrel Delivery Pass Monthly and Kestrel Senior Delivery Pass, keep running to the end of the paid billing cycle after the patient cancels; every other plan's cancellation takes effect the same day.
- **Refund terms.** Only Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual has a full-refund window (30 days) and a refund of unused whole months after that window; on every other plan both terms are nil.

## Hypothetical illustrations

- A patient aged 64 years and 11 months on the enrollment date does not meet the 65-year minimum of Kestrel Senior Delivery Pass; on the day of their 65th birthday they do.
- A patient aged exactly 18 on the enrollment date meets the minimum of Kestrel Delivery Pass Monthly.
